observations: All ten named assertions passed; assertion names and outcomes are preserved from the original evidence.json.

Six-task review loop: one implementation writer, two independent first-round reviewers, one fix writer, and two second-round reviewers. Both first-round reviewers returned FAIL and both second-round reviewers returned PASS.
Six distinct task IDs appear in the controller transcript; the final horch list shows each state done and closed true.
The controller read the isolated workers.toml directly and dispatched through horch with six run invocations in four shell cells.
All 18 waits used 30-second caps; this historical run predates the updated wait guidance.
No native subagents and no pane input were used.
Accepted defect: invoice_total_cents summed lines[:-1], dropping the final line from the subtotal; the fix commit sums every line.
The original artifacts carry no source hash and no model; both are attributed as noted above rather than taken from the original evidence.

provenance.private_transcript_note: The controller transcript stays in the harness's local store and is not published; the hash pins the private artifact used for the direct corroboration above.
provenance.prior_failure: An earlier Pi controller run from the same release era (duration 1197 s) passed 9/10; 'all done and closed' failed because two reviewers were closed after their reports were consumed while their task states were still running. That failure is preserved, and this fresh six-worker rerun passed after the CLI withheld early result fields.

privacy: Sanitized: no local absolute paths, working-directory paths, briefs, prompts, full reports, transcripts, credentials, or account-specific metadata. Task IDs, fixture commit hashes, model IDs, and artifact hashes are retained for attribution.
